name: keyset-monorepo
description: Safe, project-aware OAuth setup and verification for developers and coding agents.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@keyset/core && npm run build --workspace=@keyset/sdk && npm run build --workspace=@keyset/provider-google && npm run build --workspace=@keyset/adapter-better-auth && npm run build --workspace=@keyset/adapter-authjs && npm run build --workspace=@keyset/google-automation && npm run build --workspace=@keyset/cli && npm run build --workspace=@keyset/mcp
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
